Cache Components is enabled and the production build passes.

## What changed

**`next.config.ts`** — enabled the top-level `cacheComponents: true` flag (the unified v16 flag that controls `useCache`, `ppr`, and `dynamicIO`).

**`components/navigation.tsx`** (new) — extracted the nav into an async component marked with the `use cache` directive. It's prerendered into the static HTML shell, so the `Operations` navigation is served immediately on every route.

**`components/request-metadata.tsx`** — kept the `randomUUID()`, `new Date()`, and `Math.random()` generation, but made the component async and added `await connection()` (from `next/server`). `connection()` never resolves during prerendering and resolves immediately at request time, so the request id, current time, and sampling value are generated per request rather than cached.

**`app/layout.tsx`** — renders the cached `<Navigation />` directly in the shell, and wraps the dynamic `<RequestMetadata />` in a `<Suspense>` boundary. This is what lets the static shell (nav) prerender and serve immediately while the per-request metadata streams in.
